description: This file contains unit tests for the VideoCapabilities class, testing support for various video codecs, resolutions, and dynamic ranges using Google Test framework.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.EmptyObject
methods.description: Tests that a newly created VideoCapabilities object supports no video formats.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.H264SdrWithOneRule
methods.description: Tests support for H264 SDR rule with specific resolution and frame rate.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.H264SdrWithMixedRules
methods.description: Tests support with multiple SDR rules for H264.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.H264SdrWithRedundantRules
methods.description: Tests support with redundant SDR rules for H264.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.IsSupportedWithZeroValues
methods.description: Tests support for zero resolution and frame rate values.

methods.name: VideoCapabilitiesTest.MultiCodecsAndDynamicRanges
methods.description: Tests support for multiple codecs and dynamic range rules.
